title: Midnight (Doctor Who) — Meaning, Genes, And Nothing Else #Shorts
description:
The psychology underneath Midnight (Doctor Who) is simpler and older than the story on top. "Midnight" is the tenth episode of the fourth series of the British science fiction television series Doctor Who. Written by Russell T Davies and directed by Alice Troughton, it was first broadcast on BBC One on 14 June 2008.

Take away the meaning and Midnight (Doctor Who) still functions — that is the disturbing part. In 2010, IGN placed it second among Tennant's stories, calling it a "genuinely unsettling journey into the human condition" and describing the programme as being at "its very bleakest and best". Digital Spy ranked it fifth in its 2013 list of the ten best Doctor Who stories, describing it as unusually dark and frightening compared with the era's more camp and boisterous tendencies.
